thread:
maria: FYI ap-southeast1 GPU attaches spiking at 02:00 UTC, attach timeouts and scheduler retries. Seeing high iowait during that window.
kevin: ack. any idea what kicked off at 02:00? we had a batch job earlier but shouldn't block attaches this badly.
otis: infra-bot posted a janitor deep-clean run scheduled for 02:00. can you paste the janitor log from one of the affected nodes?
maria: pasted from gnode-ae-21:

```
2026-03-19T02:00:05Z janitor[4421]: starting deep-clean pool=scratch-ap-southeast1 concurrency=14 sampler=auto
2026-03-19T02:00:47Z kernel: nvme1n1: I/O queued=4096 avg_latency=4.2ms dev_iops=15000
2026-03-19T02:02:12Z janitor[4421]: deep-clean batch=5/40 finished duration=72s
2026-03-19T02:03:30Z gpu-provisioner: attach_timeout node=gnode-ae-21 pod=trainer-11 retry=3
```

sre_alex: infra-bot shows sampler auto-incremented concurrency due to backlog metric crossing threshold. looks like sampler aggressiveness was high.
kevin: concurrency=14 on these smaller hosts seems excessive. our safe default during attach-heavy windows is ~4. who allowed sampler to go that high?
otis: sampler logic increased based on backlog_ratio > 0.65 and no recent attach failures. but it didn't account for attach_ramp. we can quickly throttle.
kevin: mitigation suggestion: temporarily override janitor concurrency to 3 for ap-southeast1 for 1 hour.
ops-bot: runbook command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"concurrency.ap-southeast1":"3"}}'
```
maria: applied override. monitoring.
(3m later)
maria: attach latency back down to ~1.8s and attach_timeouts dropped to zero. good.
otis: short term done. long term options:
- change sampler to cap concurrency when gpu_attach_rate > X/min
- add lightweight prewarm pool (2-4 GPUs) in ap-southeast1 for sub-second attaches
- add janitor label to skip nodes with attach_inflight flag
kevin: prewarm pool cost estimate? even small reserve might be cheaper than repeated SLO breaches.
maria: rough: 2 reserved g4x instances ~ $900/mo. will run a more detailed calc.
sre_alex: note: janitor also logged CRC warnings on a few drives earlier today. could be wear or thermal.
otis: if CRC and high iops coincide we should isolate those nodes. set janitor mode conservative for nodes with crc_warn=true.
maria: opened ticket INF-8301 for hardware triage and SMART dump collection: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-8301 assigned to hw-team.
kevin: also PR to sampler: add "avoid-on-attach-burst" switch and cap logic. otis to own.
otis: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/janitor/pull/512 test harness added to simulate attach bursts.
ops-bot: metrics snapshot -> attach_failure_rate ap-southeast1 +14% at 02:00 window, janitor_iops_peak ~15k on nvme per node.
maria: action items:
- keep concurrency override for 1h (maria)
- hw ticket INF-8301 with SMART logs (maria)
- cost calc for small prewarm pool (maria)
- sampler PR to cap on attach bursts (otis -> PR 512)
kevin: file a short infra-ops epic to tune sampler defaults and add region prewarm policy.
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing thread, will update INF-8301 with findings.
